# StretchedSpriteParticleRenderer

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · record

```csharp
public sealed record StretchedSpriteParticleRenderer : ParticleRenderer
```

Types: [`ParticleRenderer`](ParticleRenderer.md)

Draws each particle as a texture pointed along its velocity and lengthened in proportion to its speed, for sparks, rain, and speed lines. Create one with [`ParticleRenderer.Stretched`](ParticleRenderer.md#stretched).

## Remarks

The texture is drawn pointing right, centered on the particle. A particle that isn't moving draws at its own rotation and length.

## Properties

### LengthPerSpeed

```csharp
public float LengthPerSpeed { get; init; }
```

How much longer a particle draws per pixel per second of speed, beyond the texture's width times its scale.

### MaxLength

```csharp
public float? MaxLength { get; init; }
```

The longest a particle draws, in pixels, so a fast particle doesn't stretch across the screen; null for no limit.

### Texture

```csharp
public ITextureSource Texture { get; }
```

Types: [`ITextureSource`](ITextureSource.md)

What each particle draws.
